Rae (Partnerships): quick check-in: need staging preview + embargo plan for marketplace listing. propose EU soft-preview Wed 2026-04-07 09:00 UTC, public announce Fri 2026-04-09 06:00 UTC. ok?
Tom (Eng): can do staging preview. will need listing JSON, hero assets, and the sdk bundle by Tue EOD. staging URL will be posted when ready.
Maya (Marketing): embargo needs 48h for EU. will prep press kit and blog draft. please confirm partner logo approval status.
Ibrahim (Product): we'll hide partner-specific pricing until legal signs contracts. feature flag controlled. also need to validate billing SKU mapping in staging.
SIsquad_bot: Reminder: SI certification slot open Thu 14:00 UTC. Request SDK artifact and terraform example to start tests.
Rae (Partnerships): actions: @Tom upload artifacts to s3, @Maya circulate embargo windows to partners, @Ibrahim set feature flag default to off for partner logos.
Tom (Eng): uploaded artifacts: s3://redwood-partner-artifacts/1799999999/sdk.zip and s3://redwood-partner-artifacts/1799999999/terraform.tar.gz. staging URL: https://staging.marketplace.redwood.ai/listing/1799999999
Maya (Marketing): got it. routing co-marketing terms to legal. if legal holds, we'll soft-launch without logos.
Ibrahim (Product): canary rollout plan: 5% -> 30m, 25% -> 1h, 70% -> 2h. rollback if error_rate > 3% or p95 > 2x SLA.
Rae (Partnerships): great. final sync Wed 15:00 UTC to confirm go/no-go for EU staging. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
